editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses a core bottleneck in transformer efficiency (sparse attention). It fits the high-velocity 'hardware_efficiency' category perfectly and allows for a beautiful 3b1b-style visualization of skipping unnecessary computation.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI model stopped reading every word and learned to only look at the ones that actually matter?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A speed-reader scanning a library shelf and only stopping to pull the specific books relevant to their search, rather than reading every single spine in the room.
